comment: Levels are measured against 5V as 0dB. The expander ratio parameter is configured with its minimum at 1 and its maximum at 0.25 (Zod.cpp:156), so the knob reads OFF at its left end; the compressor ratio runs the other way from 1 to 10 (Zod.cpp:157) and also reads OFF at its left end. The noise gate is skipped entirely while its knob is within a thousandth of a decibel of -70dB (Zod.cpp:526). Detection runs at four times the sample rate with 4ms of lookahead (Zod.cpp:142, :45). All four threshold jacks write their parameter with setValue rather than being summed with it (Zod.cpp:311, :316, :321, :326), so each takes its knob over for as long as it is patched. No range is given for those four jacks because their scale is a level in volts rather than one of the four standard shapes. A comment at Non.cpp:318 to :324 records the maker's intention to deprecate Zod.
